Retained original source characterization

Superseded; this implementation did not qualify. All 60 fresh processes completed against baseline 7d0ef03. Complete facts, repository graphs, edited dependency graphs and history snapshots agree. The compiled source-pressure profile failed the unchanged ten-percent warm-memory guard: median sampled tree RSS 307.3 → 356.4 MiB (+16.0%). The other four series passed. This record preserves every observation before retiring the structure phase's original source memo.

Native generations already used six primary/auxiliary grammar reservations, 16 MiB cumulative original UTF-8 input, sequential streaming and grouped grammar families. Ordinary closures released their originals, but the shared IndexedSources memo retained up to 32 MiB accounted text through subsequent consumers. Warm pressure had no native jobs; a native process cap alone did not resolve the observed parent retention. The subsequent implementation explicitly releases the phase's memo and must qualify independently with the same graph and performance guards.
